traces.text: Zebra Logistics and FastSupply Inc entered into a freight contract dated March 1, 2026.
The SLA requires 99.99% uptime; breach triggers $ 20,000 per incident compensation.
Maximum liability for any single claim is limited to $ 350,000.
Payment must be made in full within 45 days from the invoice date.
RapiTech Inc shall provide services from February 1, 2026 to January 31, 2028.
Each missed delivery deadline triggers a fixed penalty of $ 2,500 payable within 7 days.
This Agreement shall be interpreted under the laws of Ontario, Canada.
Either partner may exit the agreement by providing 120 days written notice to the other party.
Overdue amounts incur a penalty rate of 1.2% per month calculated on the outstanding balance.
InnoSoft Ltd and CloudBase Corp signed this SLA effective April 15, 2025.
The ceiling on aggregate damages under this Agreement is $ 1,200,000.
Service Provider guarantees 99.5% uptime; shortfall incurs a 2% monthly service credit.
All fees are payable net 30 days from the date of invoice.
TradeCo Inc shall pay PrimeBuild LLC $ 220,000 upon completion of each phase.
This contract is governed by the laws of the State of California.
